resource: Overlay entries encoded in one WORLD_OBJECT_OVERLAY delta
allocation_impact: One committed use transition changes exactly one world object; the delta carries that single overlay entry and a second entry is refused before encoding.
boundary_tests: max=1: the one changed overlay entry is carried in a delta
max+1=2: a second entry cannot be encoded by the WORLD_OBJECT_OVERLAY_DELTA_V1 payload schema
notes: Accepted by the resource owner in #162 comment 5864914163 (USE-WIRE-V1).
